Asset sensitivity over the entire scenario tree

Verified financial results. Confirmed holdings: VLP1L 107 units; Technology C 7.108 units. Only completed policies listed below are available. The main financial report has been integrated with the same confirmed holdings and closing snapshot.

Every other asset retains its selected-model trades at every node. Only the chosen asset is changed. There is no portfolio reoptimisation and no conditioning on a scenario subset. Prices, all sales and cash are replayed at their actual stages across the entire forecast law.

Definitions and interpretation

netSD is computed directly from the probability-weighted terminal portfolio return distribution against all eligible assets plus Current with cash. It is not a weighted average of component netSD scores. Every counterfactual uses the same references, probabilities and complete tree as its baseline.

Removal sells the full current holding at the initial decision, cancels this asset’s proposed entry and later trades, and retains the proceeds as cash. If no units are held, removal leaves the original policy unchanged. The stage-1-only asset case retains the exact signed first trade but cancels this asset’s later trades; other assets still execute all their model trades.

Later quantities sum gross purchases after stage 1 over complete paths. Minimum positive excludes zero; the probability-weighted median includes zero. The maximum must occur on a positive-probability path. For each quantity, the most probable actual complete signed asset schedule is replayed across the full tree; ties are deterministic, without choosing by return. Its sales and timing are retained. Stagewise quantities from incompatible paths are never combined.

A cash or short-holding violation on any positive-probability path makes the counterfactual unavailable; violating paths are not dropped. These are one-asset sensitivity diagnostics, not reoptimised or constraint-projected orders: sector, stage-purchase, historical-mean and sale-policy constraints can prevent executing a diagnostic. In particular, removal is a sale counterfactual even under No-sale.

Original Stochastic and stochA use the original 20-scenario law; Stochastic 2 uses 160,000 terminal outcomes. Compare each counterfactual with its own baseline. Do not interpret a score difference between different forecast laws as a matched model ranking.
